title: Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green)

infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the hidden room in apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) (A.P. Green) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A green TerraGroup Labs keycard reprogrammed using technical data from A.P.'s flash drive. In theory it might open a hidden room in A.P.'s apartment.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter The Unheard

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the hidden room in apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov. A TerraGroup corporate apartment key is required to acces it.
